procedure.title: 機能テスト手順(ad-hoc / playbook / 行内オプション / インベントリ切替)

steps.title: ad-hoc: 行内指定(1行目 ansible 行)
steps.command: ansible -e '{"INVENTORY": "samples/local_test/inventory.ini", "CHECK_LABEL": "機能テスト", "HOGE": "FUGA"}' db -i samples/local_test/inventory_db.ini -e HOGE=ADHOC -m shell -a 'echo "HOGE={{ HOGE }} on {{ inventory_hostname }}"'
steps.criteria:
rc == 0 and
out("HOGE=ADHOC on db01") and out("HOGE=ADHOC on db02") and
not out("HOGE=FUGA") and not out("web01|web02|web03|mon01") and
not out("UNREACHABLE|FAILED")
